source: Weapon-skill curation made directly in the dev database in July 2026 (hensei-api #452 and the golden-panel sessions) that never reached prod. Reconstructed from the #452 commit message, the golden panel references and the July session notes. 'exact' = values recorded at the time; 'derived' = computed from a recorded panel decomposition or an explicit July rule.
